subject.title: fix(acpx): keep leaked non-openai model out of the Codex ACP thinking slot

question: Should OpenClaw accept modelExplicit and appliedModel as the ACP runtime provenance/effective-model contract for this Codex ACP bug fix?
rationale: The code path is a valid bug fix, but the fallback-versus-fail-closed behavior and new runtime boundary fields are compatibility-sensitive and need maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the provenance contract
options.body: Land with modelExplicit and appliedModel because they preserve caller intent while preventing replay of a dropped inherited default.

options.title: Narrow the API first
options.body: Ask for a Codex-only or more local contract shape before merge if generic ACP runtime fields are not the desired boundary.

options.title: Defer the behavior change
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers are not ready to decide the inherited-default fallback versus explicit-model fail-closed policy.

recommendation.title: Accept the provenance contract
recommendation.body: Land with modelExplicit and appliedModel because they preserve caller intent while preventing replay of a dropped inherited default.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is assigned, requested for review, and has the strongest recent ACPX/runtime history in the checked code path.
